description: Knowledge about designing, building, testing, and maintaining software systems.

topics.name: Software Development
knowledge: Software engineering is the process of creating reliable and maintainable software.
Software development includes planning, designing, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Good software should be scalable, secure, efficient, and easy to maintain.

topics.name: Programming Concepts
knowledge: Programs are instructions that tell computers how to perform tasks.
Variables store information, functions organize logic, and algorithms solve problems.
Data structures organize data for efficient processing.
Object-oriented programming uses classes and objects to structure software.

topics.name: Software Architecture
knowledge: Software architecture defines how software components interact.
Common architectures include monolithic, client-server, and microservices.
Good architecture improves scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

topics.name: Testing
knowledge: Software testing verifies that applications work correctly.
Integration testing checks communication between components.

topics.name: Development Practices
knowledge: Version control tracks changes in software projects.
Code reviews improve quality and help find problems early.
Documentation helps developers understand and maintain systems.
Continuous integration helps teams deliver updates safely.
